scope: Four base batches, four completed 20M panels and nineteen new followup singleton queries: two Batch 02, seven Batch 03 and ten Batch 04. Ten reused Batch 04 played queries remain counted only in the original panel. Mac, pilots and abandoned transition costs remain separate.
limits: Measured VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate, not billing. Mean scaling only; panel sizes, discovered alternatives and availability vary. Inclusive scenarios retain ancillary storage/transfer/operations and recovery assumptions. Cloud-stage timing excludes preflight, retrieval, review pauses and final synthesis.

calendar_estimate.basis: Retain the previously communicated calendar window. About 15.99 remaining cloud-stage hours excludes preflight, retrieval, independent reviews and final synthesis. Regional capacity and any new scientific obligations can add delay. This is a conditional estimate, not a deadline.
